reuse_note: Public current stats attributed to nohumans.directory (CC BY 4.0 per publisher terms); selected fields only, not a raw immutable response or licensed history.
interpretation_of_differences: The two snapshots have different underlying latest-per-endpoint cohorts. These count differences are NOT 1259 independent new paying customers, 1042 newly successful paid deliveries, a causal improvement, or a longitudinal conversion rate.
limitations: Paid verification attempts are operator-funded probes, not purchases by independent customers.
Payment-required outcomes include cases where settlement is not established; failure to deliver an accepted response is not a settled-loss rate.
The operator's delivered labels include retrospective chain-verified corrections, not independent proof of useful content quality.
Cumulative merchant sales are vendor-reported and not independently replayed on chain; no distinct customer, repeat buyer or margin evidence.
The snapshots are selected source fields, not raw API response archives; different latest-per-endpoint cohorts prohibit a same-sample performance-change claim.
No verified AgentMine customers, revenues, supplier time savings, paid willingness-to-pay or real delivery economics.
decision: No new buyer-side conversion evidence despite more operator-probed endpoints. Keep generic post-payment verification/exchange fee hypothesis unpromoted; prioritize independently observed buyer task value and explicit opt-in WTP.
